summary.en: As speed approaches the speed of light, momentum grows faster than the classical mv predicts, and even a mass at rest carries an intrinsic energy given by E = mc², the basis of nuclear energy release.
summary.et: Kiiruse lähenedes valguse kiirusele kasvab impulss kiiremini, kui klassikaline mv ennustab, ning ka seisuolekus massile vastab sisemine energia, mille annab E = mc² — see on tuumaenergia vabanemise alus.
